entities.title: GitHub workflows
entities.summary: The repository's only CI workflow, Validate specification.
entities.purpose: Runs the repository's structural checks and the side-by-side page check on GitHub Actions for every push and pull request.
boundaries: It runs the scripts in tools/ and nothing else: no library's build or tests, and no deployment or release.
The workflow token is read-only (permissions: contents: read).
.github/ holds nothing but this folder, so it has no .dev of its own.
